comparison_boundary: recorded synthetic two-sided engagement history versus recorded historical two-sided state-based history

latent_state.description: Pineland latent armed presence, engagements, control, logistics, and information state

missingness: national-level location records are retained as unmapped
source coverage is not assumed complete
primary_observation_stream.severity: fatality interval low/best/high; no latent-fatality correction applied
primary_observation_stream.alignment_note: The primary target is two-sided state-based violence; one-sided violence is retained as an observational diagnostic. Pineland contact records represent realized two-sided engagements, so incidence is construct-aligned but remains a stress test rather than an identified fatality-rate map.

no district-week date field in the extracted table

synthetic_observation_operator.source: Pineland recording configuration and synthetic records
synthetic_observation_operator.contact_mapping: a recorded Pineland contact is retained as a synthetic recorded engagement target; it is not relabeled as a UCDP fatality
synthetic_observation_operator.false_events: kept separate from latent event truth and excluded from primary contact counts

calibration_guard.reason: The untuned model emits sparse engagement records and no identified mapping from unitless reported severity to UCDP fatalities; fitting a two-parameter count/severity bridge would confound event semantics with reporting and is therefore not performed.
